title.rendered: International Coproduction Fund (IKF) 2026: Funding Opportunity for International Music, Dance and Theatre Projects

excerpt.rendered: The Goethe-Institut International Coproduction Fund (IKF) supports international artistic collaborations that bring creators from different cultural backgrounds together to develop innovative productions and new approaches to intercultural exchange. The fund is designed to encourage international coproduction, cultural dialogue, artistic collaboration, and the development of new creative networks within a global context.
